nop passed: tests pass on the unsolved environment

behavior_in_tests: The tests cover core grouping, rounding, splits, selected validation, release contents, reproducibility, and scale, but do not test several required behaviors such as UTF-8 handling, malformed headers and whitespace-corrupted records, many overflow cases, unknown destination/source combinations, or broad split-contract details.

anti_cheating_measures: The runtime repository already contains a complete-looking executable Python implementation at tools/reconcile-pack, exposing the intended behavior and allowing a solver to bypass implementing the stubbed C components.

valid_failure_modes: The verifier performs apt and network downloads from external services during test execution, so dependency availability or network failure can cause failure unrelated to the submitted repository.
pinned_dependencies: The Dockerfile uses the mutable python:3.13-slim-bookworm image and unversioned apt packages; only the pytest-related uv packages in the test script are pinned.

oracle_investigates: The provided solution only runs chmod and make release; it does not inspect the repository, history, documentation, or failures to derive a repair, and relies on the preexisting implementation artifact.
